targets.note: Console > Space profile with no image: the letter, Choose image… (the file picker), Choose from Files…, and the line that says drop or paste works.
A wide logo pasted in (Cmd-V): the square crop with zoom, and the preview on the rail, the sign-in page and the switcher, then Save image.
Choose from Files…: every picture in the Space's folders the person can see, newest first, with a search (it used to list only the empty Space root).
The image saved: it shows in the Space image row, with Remove image.
The rail tile shows the Space image in place of the letter, and the switcher shows it beside the Space's name.
The sign-in page of a Space with an image: the image in place of the letter.
An invite's join page: the Space image above who invited you.
